ideas.title: Investigating Obstruction of Federal Law Enforcement in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of obstruction of federal law enforcement by Minnesota Governor Tim Walz and Minneapolis Mayor Jacob Frey, and examine the implications for the state's governance and immigration enforcement.
questions: What are the allegations against Governor Walz and Mayor Frey?
How has the state responded to the investigation?
